title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-08

ai_review.summary: Restored tape brings the intense, jam‑filled flavor of late‑1970 Dead with surprisingly good sound despite an unknown source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a favorite ’70 show with flowing, intense jams and great playing. Recent restoration work has lifted the recording from its earlier “crappy” state to a listenable level, though the exact source (soundboard vs audience) isn’t specified.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed positive reviews (4 and 5 stars) highlight excellent musical performance and a cleaned‑up recording, leading to an overall high rating but limited sample size keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recent restoration work has improved clarity and reduced earlier tape issues; still no explicit mention of soundboard or audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list described as tricky but the jams flow intensely, creating a compelling musical arc throughout the show.
